ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme dominance of low-intensity dark pixels (~90%) punctuated by high-intensity white speckling and localized grey-scale mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the primary field with high-contrast white speckling distributed randomly; a dense cluster of white/grey pixel blobs is concentrated at the distal region of the right lobe fracture site.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch visible at the central intersection, though the vertex is partially obscured by localized water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge presents low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations; the right lobe presents high-amplitude, irregular macro-serrations and significant pixel-depth depressions consistent with tissue loss.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a standard convex sweep tapering to a sharp distal point; the right lobe trajectory is truncated by a non-linear, vertical jagged fracture.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity circular pixel clusters (barnacles) are densely grouped at the terminal tip of the left lobe and along the superior jagged margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, white linear tracks (rake marks) are visible traversing the left lobe, predominantly oriented in parallel diagonal vectors from inner to outer edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural amputation of the right fluke lobe, exhibiting a traumatic, jagged margin and significant reduction in total surface area relative to the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy colonization of acorn-type barnacles specifically concentrated along the perimeter of the right lobe's traumatic truncation.
